findings.title: ASUS Security Advisory: Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware (CVE-2026-88707, CVE-2026-88708, CVE-2026-88709, CVE-2026-88710)
findings.summary_md: ASUS published a security advisory and four CVE records (CVE-2026-88707, CVE-2026-88708, CVE-2026-88709, and CVE-2026-88710) addressing vulnerabilities in a remote file access feature of ASUS Router firmware across the 3.0.0.4.386, 3.0.0.4.388, and 3.0.0.6.102 firmware series. The most severe flaw, CVE-2026-88710 (CWE-78 OS command injection, CVSS v4.0 score 8.7), allows an unauthenticated nearby user to chain unauthenticated queries, identifier guessing, credential overwriting, and command injection to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges. The advisory also covers CVE-2026-88709 (CVSS v4.0 7.0), a physical USB directory-name command injection flaw executing commands with root privileges, CVE-2026-88707 (CVSS v4.0 7.1), an out-of-bounds write triggered by HTTP parameters exceeding buffer length, and CVE-2026-88708 (CVSS v4.0 5.3), an off-by-one error triggered by a crafted packet header length.

findings.title: Zoom Security Bulletin ZSB-26023: CVE-2026-108186 Improper Input Validation Privilege Escalation in Zoom Workplace for Windows
findings.summary_md: Zoom published security bulletin ZSB-26023 for CVE-2026-108186, a CWE-20 improper input validation vulnerability in Zoom Workplace for Windows affecting version 7.1 prior to 7.1.8. Rated critical with a CVSS v3.1 base score of 9.6 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H), the flaw allows an unauthenticated user to conduct an escalation of privilege via network access across a changed security scope. The CVE record was reserved by Zoom on October 9, 2026 and published on November 10, 2026.

findings.title: Zoom Security Bulletin ZSB-26024: CVE-2026-108187 Origin Validation Error Privilege Escalation in Zoom Workplace for Windows
findings.summary_md: Zoom published security bulletin ZSB-26024 for CVE-2026-108187, a CWE-346 origin validation error in Zoom Workplace for Windows that allows an unauthenticated user to conduct an escalation of privilege via network access. Rated high with a CVSS v3.1 base score of 8.1 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N), the CVE record lists affected versions prior to 7.1.5, while the Zoom Workplace for Windows 7.1.8 release remediates both CVE-2026-108187 and CVE-2026-108186. The record was reserved by Zoom on October 9, 2026 and published on November 10, 2026.
